mainEntity.name: What is included in a bedroom-and-bathroom suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bedroom-and-bathroom addition is a newly constructed suite built onto your existing home that includes both a dedicated sleeping space and an attached private bath. Homeowners commonly build these as primary master suites, in-law suites for aging relatives, or private quarters for returning adult children. Unlike a basic bedroom addition, adding a bathroom requires extending major plumbing lines, venting, and drainage into the new footprint. Planning the right scope depends on who will use the room; for instance, creating an accessible space for older family members might call for zero-threshold walk-in showers and wider doorways, which Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms coordinates during initial design.
acceptedAnswer.description: A bedroom-and-bathroom addition provides a fully integrated living suite, combining a private bedroom with an attached bath requiring dedicated plumbing, electrical, and structural connections.
